subject: Check if the server is currently running the feature before cron run (#838)
reason: The change only reorders two side-effect-free condition checks in serverCron: run_with_period(100) is a pure macro (an if over server.cronloops and server.hz with no state mutation, server.h:638), so testing server.cluster_enabled or moduleCount() before it instead of after yields the exact same calls to clusterCron() and modulesCron() at the exact same ticks. It is a performance refactor with no behaviour change, so no scenario can distinguish the builds.
